provided_toolkits.name: inventory
provided_toolkits.description: Knowledge Graph for codebase understanding. Build graphs from multiple data sources, search entities, analyze dependencies, and visualize code structure.

toolkit_config.description: Configure your knowledge graph storage and processing settings. Data sources (repositories, wikis, etc.) are added after creation through the UI or tools.

bucket.description: Storage bucket for knowledge graph data and configurations

llm_model.description: LLM model for entity and relation extraction

sources.description: List of source toolkit IDs for data ingestion

source_configs.description: Per-source configuration (keyed by toolkit ID). Each config can have: file_patterns (whitelist), exclude_patterns (blacklist), branch, preset

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort for model calls: none, low, medium or high (empty keeps the model's default). Use none for reasoning models such as Qwen3 to avoid long thinking. A caller-supplied llm_settings.reasoning_effort overrides it.

provided_tools.name: run_ingestion
provided_tools.description: Run ingestion pipeline for a toolkit to build/update the knowledge graph. Uses EliteAClient to fetch from the source toolkit.

toolkit_id.description: Toolkit ID of the data source (GitHub, ADO Repos, GitLab, etc.)

branch.description: Branch to analyze (uses toolkit default if not specified)

full_rebuild.description: Force full rebuild instead of incremental update

provided_tools.name: delta_update
provided_tools.description: Update specific files from a toolkit (faster than full ingestion)

toolkit_id.description: Toolkit ID of the data source

provided_tools.name: remove_source_entities
provided_tools.description: Remove all entities from a specific source toolkit from the graph

toolkit_id.description: Toolkit ID whose entities should be removed

provided_tools.name: list_ingested_sources
provided_tools.description: List all source toolkits that have been ingested into the current graph, with entity counts per source

provided_tools.name: list_graphs
provided_tools.description: List all available knowledge graphs in this inventory

provided_tools.name: load_graph
provided_tools.description: Load/switch to a specific knowledge graph

graph_name.description: Name of the graph to load

provided_tools.name: get_graph_info
provided_tools.description: Get metadata about the currently loaded graph including sources, entity counts, and last update

provided_tools.name: search_graph
provided_tools.description: Search for entities with token matching. Supports 'chat message' finding 'ChatMessageHandler', file patterns, layer and source filtering

entity_type.description: Filter by entity type (class, function, service, etc.)

layer.description: Filter by layer (code, service, data, product, domain)

source_toolkit.description: Filter by source toolkit (e.g., 'github', 'ado_repos', or toolkit ID)

output_format.description: Output format: 'text' or 'json' (includes edges for visualization)

provided_tools.name: get_entity
provided_tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific entity including properties, relations, and all source citations

entity_name.description: Entity reference - copy from search results. Supports 'Name', 'Name (type)', or 'Name (type) @ source - path'

provided_tools.name: get_entity_content
provided_tools.description: Retrieve the source code for an entity using its citation

entity_name.description: Entity reference - copy from search results. Supports 'Name', 'Name (type)', or 'Name (type) @ source - path'

provided_tools.name: impact_analysis
provided_tools.description: Analyze what entities would be impacted by changes (downstream) or dependencies (upstream). Works across all sources.

entity_name.description: Entity reference - copy from search results. Supports 'Name', 'Name (type)', or 'Name (type) @ source - path'

direction.description: 'downstream' (what depends on this) or 'upstream' (what this depends on)

provided_tools.name: get_related_entities
provided_tools.description: Get entities related to a specific entity, optionally filtered by relation type

entity_name.description: Entity reference - copy from search results. Supports 'Name', 'Name (type)', or 'Name (type) @ source - path'

relation_type.description: Filter by relation type (CALLS, IMPORTS, EXTENDS, etc.)

provided_tools.name: query_graph
provided_tools.description: Query knowledge graph with structured filters (no similarity search). Supports JQL-like syntax: 'type:class layer:code' or 'related:UserService type:function dir:out'. Use for precise code queries.

query.description: JQL-like query string. Syntax: type:class,function layer:code file:*.py name:User related:Entity rel:calls dir:out limit:50. Example: 'type:class layer:code' or 'related:UserService type:function'

types.description: Comma-separated entity types to filter (e.g., 'class,function,method'). Use layer names like 'code', 'service', 'data' to get all types in that layer.

related_to.description: Find entities related to this entity. Copy from search results - supports 'Name', 'Name (type)', or full 'Name (type) @ source - path' format.

relation_types.description: Comma-separated relation types to filter when using related_to (e.g., 'calls,imports,contains')

direction.description: Relation direction when using related_to: 'in', 'out', or 'both'

has_relations.description: If true, only return entities with relations; if false, only isolated entities

provided_tools.name: get_cross_source_relations
provided_tools.description: Get relations that connect entities from different data sources (e.g., Jira ticket -> GitHub PR)

provided_tools.name: get_stats
provided_tools.description: Get statistics about the knowledge graph (entity counts by type, source, layer)

provided_tools.name: list_entities_by_type
provided_tools.description: List all entities of a specific type across all sources

entity_type.description: Type of entities to list (class, function, service, etc.)

source_toolkit.description: Filter by source toolkit (e.g., 'github', 'ado_repos', or toolkit ID)

provided_tools.name: list_entities_by_layer
provided_tools.description: List entities by semantic layer (code, service, data, product, domain, etc.)

source_toolkit.description: Filter by source toolkit (e.g., 'github', 'ado_repos', or toolkit ID)

provided_tools.name: list_entities_by_source
provided_tools.description: List all entities from a specific source toolkit

source_toolkit.description: Source toolkit identifier (e.g., 'github', 'ado_repos', or toolkit ID)

provided_tools.name: list_presets
provided_tools.description: List available language presets for ingestion (python, typescript, java, etc.)

provided_tools.name: get_preset_info
provided_tools.description: Get details about a specific language preset including file patterns

preset_name.description: Name of the preset (python, typescript, java, etc.)

provided_tools.name: get_cache_stats
provided_tools.description: Get statistics about the local graph cache including size, count, and individual graph details

provided_tools.name: cleanup_cache
provided_tools.description: Force cleanup of stale graphs from the cache (normally runs automatically in background)

provided_tools.name: get_ingestion_status
provided_tools.description: Report the ingestion currently running for this toolkit, if any, with its progress. Used by the sources view to show a run in flight.

provided_tools.name: get_sources_status
provided_tools.description: Get status of all sources added to the knowledge graph. Shows ingestion status (pending/in_progress/completed/error), last update time, and entity counts for each source.

provided_tools.name: get_entities_by_ids
provided_tools.description: Fetch entities by their IDs together with the edges connecting them. Used by the chat view to display and highlight the entities a response drew on.

entity_ids.description: List of entity IDs to fetch

include_edges.description: Include the edges between the returned entities

include_bridging.description: Include bridging nodes that connect otherwise disjoint clusters

max_bridge_length.description: Maximum path length when bridging (4 means up to 3 intermediate nodes)

provided_tools.name: get_entity_neighbors
provided_tools.description: Get the neighbours of an entity up to a given depth, with the edges connecting them. Used by the graph view's context menu to expand connections 1-3 levels deep.

entity_id.description: ID of the entity to expand from

depth.description: Number of hops to expand (1, 2 or 3); values outside that range are clamped

provided_tools.name: normalize_types
provided_tools.description: Normalize all entity types in the graph to canonical lowercase forms. Consolidates variations like 'Feature', 'Features', 'feature' into 'feature'. Run this to reduce type fragmentation.

provided_tools.name: rebuild_indices
provided_tools.description: Rebuild all graph indices (name, type, file, source). Use after manual modifications or to fix index inconsistencies. Also normalizes entity types.

provided_tools.name: smart_normalize_types
provided_tools.description: Use the configured LLM to map uncommon entity types onto the canonical set, on the graph as it is stored now. No engine runs it after an ingestion; run it when the graph has stray types.

threshold.description: Only normalize types whose entity count is below this

dry_run.description: Show the proposed mapping without applying it

batch_size.description: Number of types to send per LLM call

provided_tools.name: import_graph
provided_tools.description: Import a graph.json document (the node-link graph the Python engine kept in this toolkit's artifact bucket) into the graph store, replacing the stored graph. Re-running it replaces the graph again. Refused while an ingestion runs, and refused over native ingestion state unless replace_ingestion_state is set.

artifact_name.description: Name of the graph document in this toolkit's artifact bucket

replace_ingestion_state.description: Delete the toolkit's native ingestion state (source status, document versions) with the old graph

provided_tools.name: export_graph
provided_tools.description: Write the stored graph to this toolkit's artifact bucket as graph.json (the Python engine's node-link layout), replacing the object there.

provided_tools.name: get_type_stats
provided_tools.description: Get detailed statistics about entity types including counts and potential duplicates. Useful for identifying type fragmentation before normalization.

show_all.description: Show all types instead of top 50

provided_tools.name: link_toolkits_to_tools
provided_tools.description: Create PROVIDES_TOOL relationships between toolkit entities and their tools. Links based on file paths (same directory), naming patterns, and parent_toolkit properties. Run after ingestion to improve toolkit-tool connectivity.

dry_run.description: Preview changes without modifying the graph

provided_tools.name: connect_orphan_nodes
provided_tools.description: Find isolated entities (no relationships) and connect them to related entities using word overlap scoring. Creates RELATED_TO relationships based on name similarity. Helps reduce graph fragmentation.

min_score.description: Minimum similarity score (0-1) required to create a relationship

max_connections.description: Maximum connections to create per orphan node

dry_run.description: Preview changes without modifying the graph

provided_tools.name: validate_relationships
provided_tools.description: Validate existing relationships using heuristic rules. Checks for issues like self-loops, invalid relation types for entity combinations, and missing required relationships. Returns validation report.

fix_issues.description: Automatically fix fixable issues (remove invalid relationships)

provided_toolkits.name: inventory_search
provided_toolkits.description: Read-only access to an Inventory Knowledge Graph. Search entities, explore relationships, and understand code structure from an existing knowledge graph.

toolkit_config.description: Connect to an existing Inventory Knowledge Graph to search and explore entities. Select an inventory toolkit that has already been configured and has data ingested.

inventory_toolkit.description: ID of an existing Inventory toolkit to connect to

provided_tools.name: search_knowledge_graph
provided_tools.description: Search the knowledge graph for entities (code, documentation, configs, etc.) matching a query. Returns entities with their types, sources, and relevance scores.

query.description: Search query for finding entities (e.g., 'user authentication', 'database connection')

top_k.description: Maximum number of results to return

entity_type.description: Filter by entity type (class, function, method, service, etc.)

layer.description: Filter by layer (code, service, data, documentation, domain)

provided_tools.name: get_entity_details
provided_tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific entity including its properties, description, content, and source citations.

entity_name.description: Entity reference - copy from search results. Supports: 'Name', 'Name (type)', or 'Name (type) @ source - path'

include_relations.description: Include related entities in the response

provided_tools.name: get_related_entities
provided_tools.description: Get entities related to a specific entity. Shows dependencies, callers, imports, and other relationships.

entity_name.description: Entity reference - copy from search results. Supports: 'Name', 'Name (type)', or 'Name (type) @ source - path'

relation_type.description: Filter by relation type (CALLS, IMPORTS, EXTENDS, IMPLEMENTS, CONTAINS, etc.)

provided_tools.name: query_graph
provided_tools.description: Query the knowledge graph with structured filters using JQL-like syntax. No similarity search - exact filtering by type, layer, file patterns, and relationships.

query.description: JQL-like query. Syntax: type:class,function layer:code file:*.py name:User related:Entity rel:calls dir:out limit:50

types.description: Comma-separated entity types (class, function, method, service, etc.)

layers.description: Comma-separated layers: code, service, data, documentation, domain, product, configuration, testing

related_to.description: Find entities related to this entity. Copy from search results.

provided_tools.name: list_entity_types
provided_tools.description: List all entity types in the knowledge graph with their counts. Useful for understanding what's in the graph before searching.

provided_tools.name: investigate
provided_tools.description: Ask a natural language question about the knowledge graph. An AI agent will search the graph, explore relationships, and provide a comprehensive answer with citations. Use this for complex questions that require reasoning across multiple entities.

question.description: The question to investigate (e.g., 'How does the authentication system work?', 'What components depend on the UserService?')

entity_types.description: Comma-separated entity types to focus on (e.g., 'class,function,service')

layers.description: Comma-separated layers to search: code, service, data, documentation, domain
